# Milestone (ميلستون)

> Milestone is a Saudi brand of premium kitchen and home appliances, founded in 2024 in Riyadh. Slogan: "The Integration Art". Tagline: "Where Utility Meets Design".

This site is the Milestone showroom website. Products are sold at the official online store, milestone.website.

## Key pages
- [Showroom website](https://milestonechannels.netlify.app/): brand story, appliance collection, channels and contact
- [Official online store](https://milestone.website): every appliance, specifications, and Design Your Kitchen
- [About Milestone](https://milestone.website/about): company story and services
- [Full details for AI assistants](https://milestonechannels.netlify.app/llms-full.txt)
